acceptanceCovered: the /kudos page renders all six regions with header and footer — proven by e2e/kudos-board-layout.spec.ts:8, which asserts header, banner title, wordmark, submit pill, Sunner search, the HIGHLIGHT/SPOTLIGHT/ALL KUDOS sections, the sidebar's five stat labels, the leaderboard heading and the footer, plus a toHaveURL guard that the page is /kudos and not a gate redirect

hashtag and department filters re-filter both the highlight carousel and the all-kudos feed — proven by e2e/kudos-board-interactions.spec.ts:79 and :116, each selecting option index 1 (not 0, which the reveal batch makes unfalsifiable), asserting every visible card contains the selected value, that the unfiltered feed held a card lacking it, and that clearing restores those cards; cross-section behaviour proven at :151 (TC d01729d4) with the carousel advanced off page 1 first

the heart toggles count and active state, and is disabled on the viewer's own kudos — proven by e2e/kudos-board-feed-interactions.spec.ts:8 (increment then decrement, with aria-pressed asserted true then false) and :45 (at least one disabled heart AND at least one enabled heart must coexist, so the disabled state proves something)
copy link writes the clipboard and shows the toast Link copied — proven by e2e/kudos-board-feed-interactions.spec.ts:72 with clipboard permissions granted, asserting the exact toast string

the filtered empty state shows the no-kudos message — proven by e2e/kudos-board-feed-interactions.spec.ts:140, which walks every department option against a pinned hashtag until a zero-match combination is found and fails explicitly if none exists

no page-level horizontal scroll at 375, 768 or 1440 — measured scrollWidth == clientWidth at all three widths after the width and min-height fixes; captures in kudos-mobile-375px.png, kudos-tablet-768px.png, kudos-desktop-1440px.png

findings.summary: navigator.clipboard optional-chained, so when the API is absent entirely (insecure origin, embedded webview) await undefined resolved and the success toast fired for a link that was never copied. BR-007 covered denial but not absence. Fixed at seal time: absence now returns early with no toast.

star-tier-tooltip.tsx and spotlight-name-cloud.tsx each own a role=tooltip with no cross-component coordination, so hovering one and then keyboard-focusing the other leaves two in the DOM, violating dom-contract F32. Not exercised by the suite, which only tests isolated hover. Deferred: the fix needs tooltip-active state lifted to page level, which is not worth destabilising a verified suite at seal.
Filtering to CECV10 can surface two zero-attachment records in the ALL KUDOS feed, a narrow dom-contract F31 gap. Cosmetic, no assertion depends on it.
Four kudosPage.* i18n keys were added but the components use hardcoded literals in those positions. Either wire them up or remove them.
Two equally-correct patterns are used for resetting state on filter change; one dead fallback expression and one intentionally-unused prop also remain. No behavioural effect.
